note: NASA VTAD’s original Saturn globe and ring meshes, retaining their textures and relative proportions. Calibration uses the catalog 280,360 km span to the F ring in the source’s 120,536 km equatorial-diameter units. The model’s outer edge is within 1% of that span. This is a main-ring view; the diffuse E ring and individual particles are not represented.
